messages:
Ravi: deploy-bot blocked the promote — manifest signature verification failed for service-notifications. tagging @Infra-Liam @SRE-Ella, this is in today's change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote 9601 ABORTED: manifest-signature.invalid for manifest://service-notifications/2026-03-24/manifest.json (sig v1 mismatch).

Nora: Any chance this is just clock drift on the signing host? we've seen expired sigs when clocks skew.

Infra-Liam: Checking signing service. runner-compiler-03 signed the manifest at 2026-03-24T09:12:00Z but our verifier saw signature timestamp 2026-03-24T09:12:00Z and rejected due to key id rotation. The key used is old-key-2026-02 which was rotated yesterday.

SRE-Ella: Confirmed: key-rotation job rotated signing key but CI didn't pick up new public key in the verifier bundle. So new manifests are signed with old key id but the verifier expects new-key-2026-03.

Ravi: Quick unblock options: 1) re-sign manifest with new key and publish (requires CI artifact rewrite + manifest update), 2) pin promote to last passing manifest (manifest-v2026-03-23) which passed verification, or 3) temporarily add old-key-2026-02 to verifier bundle (fast but security noisy). Thoughts?

Nora: Product prefers not to touch signing configs. Pinning is safest for change window. We can rotate verifier bundle in next deploy cycle after coordination.

Infra-Liam: Re-adding old key to verifier bundle is a 1-line config flip and immediate, but it widens trust window. If we pin, we avoid changing signing or verifier now.

SRE-Ella: Risk note: if we leave old key active we must ensure it's revoked properly later. For today, pin to manifest-v2026-03-23 to keep the cut. I'll open INC-2026-113 to track rotation mismatch and add key-revocation task.

Ravi: I'll do a manual pin to manifest-v2026-03-23 and re-run deploy-bot. Adding release-note: "Promotion paused due to manifest signature verification issue; promoting last-known-good manifest while we resolve key rotation."

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual manifest-pin requested by Ravi. Promote queued for manifest-v2026-03-23. Smoke expected in ~2m.

Infra-Liam: Also capturing signing service logs and rotation timeline. Will produce a short remediation doc for key rotation process.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Smoke for manifest-v2026-03-23 PASSED. Promote completed.

Ravi: Cut complete. INC-2026-113 created with links to signing logs and verifier config; postmortem scheduled. Thanks all.
